description_en: Queries all Enhanced Monitoring metrics that are supported by an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于获取RDS PostgreSQL实例支持的所有增强监控指标
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-available-metrics --db-instance-name pgm-bp1s1j103lo60000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAvailableMetrics

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_name

Items.description_en: Details of the Enhanced Monitoring metric

Description.description_en: The description of the Enhanced Monitoring metric
Description.example: sys cpu使用率，sys cpu使用量 / cpu总量

Dimension.description_en:
The category of the Enhanced Monitoring metric. Valid values:

os: OS metric
db: database metric
Dimension.description_zh:
增强指标类别。返回值：
os：操作系统指标。
db：数据库指标

GroupKey.description_en: The key of the group to which the Enhanced Monitoring metric belongs

GroupKeyType.description_en: The name of the group to which the Enhanced Monitoring metric belongs
GroupKeyType.description_zh: 增强指标所在分组的名称

Method.description_en:
The method that is used to aggregate the monitoring data of the Enhanced Monitoring metric. Valid values:

avg: The system calculates the average value of the Enhanced Monitoring metric.
min: The system calculates the minimum value of the Enhanced Monitoring metric.
max: The system calculates the maximum value of the Enhanced Monitoring metric
Method.description_zh:
增强指标统计方法。返回值：
avg：统计平均值。
min：统计最小值。
max：统计最大值

MetricsKey.description_en: The key of the Enhanced Monitoring metric

MetricsKeyAlias.description_en: The alias of the Enhanced Monitoring metric

SortRule.description_en: The serial number of the Enhanced Monitoring metric

Unit.description_en: The unit of the Enhanced Monitoring metric

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of enhanced monitoring metrics that are available for the instance
TotalRecordCount.description_zh: 实例支持的增强指标总数
